description: What this one paper reports. Use only passages you retrieved from this paper. Copy names and values exactly as the paper writes them. Leave a list empty or a field null when the passages don't state it. Never use general knowledge or typical values.

paper.description: How the paper identifies itself on its first page, copied exactly as printed

title.description: The paper's full title, copied exactly

firstAuthor.description: The family name of the first author

journal.description: The journal's name as printed, or null

year.description: The year of publication, or null

doi.description: The DOI, such as 10.1002/aenm.202400002, or null

anodes.description: Each anode sample this paper makes and tests itself (empty for a review)

sample.description: The sample name exactly as the paper writes it, with nothing added

family.description: graphite/hard carbon for a composite of graphite and hard carbon

precursor.description: The starting material as the paper names it, or null

method.description: How the sample was made, in the paper's words, or null

temperature.description: The final heat-treatment temperature with its unit, only if the quote states it, otherwise null

quote.description: A passage copied word for word from this paper, changing and adding nothing, not even a full stop. It must contain the values in this entry.

fullCells.description: Each full cell this paper assembles and tests

anodeSample.description: The anode sample name exactly as the paper writes it

cathode.description: The cathode exactly as the paper names it

cathodeFormula.description: The cathode's chemical formula as the paper writes it, or null

quote.description: A passage copied word for word from this paper that names this cathode and anode, changing and adding nothing

cathodeShortName.description: The abbreviation the paper uses for the cathode, such as NVP, or null

materials.description: The electrolyte, separator, current collectors, binder and additives this paper uses

value.description: Exactly as the quote states it

quote.description: A passage copied word for word from this paper that contains the value, changing and adding nothing

performance.description: Values this paper reports for its own anode samples and full cells

sample.description: The anode sample name exactly as the paper writes it; for a full cell, the anode sample in it

metric.description: Capacity retention is a percentage; capacity after cycling is a capacity

value.description: The value with its unit, copied exactly from the quote

condition.description: The current density or C-rate, number of cycles and temperature, as the quote states them, or null

quote.description: A passage copied word for word from this paper that contains the value, changing and adding nothing
